fact: ITWeb reports, citing Standard Bank, that CIPS interbank payments between Africa and China in renminbi have gone live and were inaugurated at the South African Reserve Bank.
Standard Bank says China's CIPS has gone live for interbank payments between Africa and China in renminbi, inaugurated at the South African Reserve Bank in November 2025.
Standard Bank says it was granted a licence at the Lujiazui Forum to offer CIPS transactions for renminbi interbank payments between Africa and China, available on its platforms from September 2025.
The document says Transactions Cleared on an Immediate Basis (TCIB) is being developed to enable immediate low-value cross-border payments in the region.
Standard Bank's Nthabiseng Sibanda says the bank uses China's CIPS as a direct route for renminbi transactions, reaching 12 African countries.
Standard Bank's Nthabiseng Sibanda says the bank has processed more than R21 billion ($1.3 billion) through CIPS since its inception.
